# Gorad

> Gorad Pvt Ltd (Bengaluru, India) builds the Gorad Factory Platform: composable, on-premise manufacturing software for visual inspection, machine data and quality. It serves discrete manufacturers worldwide. The platform is in early access, with a pilot programme running before general release.

Key facts:

- Company vision: Factories where every part is checked and every decision can be trusted and backed by data.
- Company mission: We build inspection and factory software that is safe by design, runs inside the plant, and can be changed by the people who run the line.
- Company: Gorad Pvt Ltd, CIN U62099KA2026PTC214948.
- Founder: Gokulramesh Dhanasekar (https://www.linkedin.com/in/gokulramesh-d/), who has built and deployed more than 30 production vision inspection systems in aerospace, automotive and heavy engineering.
- Platform Core: users and roles, offline licensing, site/line/station master data, append-only audit trail, event bus, updates and backup from the web interface.
- Gorad Vision: fail-closed visual inspection. A part is OK only if every expected view reports OK; errors, timeouts and missing views produce NG. The verdict is journaled before the PLC output. Only signed, verified programs go live. Classical tools (presence, measurement, colour, codes, polarity) and AI tools (anomaly, detection, OCR, classification, segmentation) in one program.
- Gorad Connect: PLC and meter gateway. Modbus TCP, Siemens S7 and OPC UA (client). Maps tags to standard events (machine.state, production.count, measurement, alarm) with store-and-forward through network outages. Read-only by default.
- Apps (early access): SPC, NCR/CAPA, Line Performance (OEE, Andon, downtime), Traceability, Maintenance, Tool & Fixture Life, Label & Dispatch, Skills & Training, Calibration & MSA. Energy & Carbon is planned.
- Deployment: Ubuntu appliance, virtual machine or customer RHEL server; browser user interface. Runs fully offline in air-gapped plants (offline licence, USB program release).
- Cameras: GenICam / GigE Vision industrial cameras and USB cameras.
- Not available today: EtherNet/IP, OPC UA server, native Windows server install, 3D inspection, full solder-joint AOI, very high-speed line-scan web inspection, MES/ERP replacement.

The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://www.gorad.in/llms-full.txt).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.gorad.in/): overview, fail-closed inspection, industries, advantages, how we work, philosophy
- [Gorad Factory Platform](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/): layers, Platform Core, app catalogue
- [Gorad Vision](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/vision/): inspection cycle, safety rules, tools, station types, PLC and cameras
- [Gorad Connect](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/connect/): protocols, standard events, store-and-forward
- [Industries](https://www.gorad.in/industries/): each sector page lists typical 2D applications with their usual camera and lighting setup. Automotive: stamped parts, welds and spot welds, 2D gauging of machined parts, die-cast and forged parts, rubber and plastic mouldings, seals and clips, threads and holes, harnesses and connectors, part numbers/VIN/DPM codes, bearings and gears, painted parts, variant checks before assembly. Electronics: component presence, orientation and value markings, markings and labels, busbars and heatsinks, transformers and coils, connectors and terminals, conformal coating under UV, cable routing. Building materials: tiles and slabs one piece at a time, sanitaryware, 2D size and squareness, shade and colour, pallet counts. Packaging: labels and print, date and lot codes, cartons, caps and closures, fill level, blisters and trays, pack contents, pallet labels. Aerospace: foreign objects on parts, fasteners and rivets, drilled holes, sealant beads, part marking (DPM/OCR), 2D gauging, avionics board presence/polarity, wire harnesses and connectors. Heavy engineering: casting and forging surfaces, weld beads (visible defects), bolts and torque marks, nameplate OCR, 2D gauging, painted surfaces (runs, coverage). Pharma: vials and ampoules (cracks, fill level, cap and seal), blister packs, tablets and capsules in packs, label and print verification, Data Matrix reading with indicative grading, pre-filled syringes, cartons and leaflets. Out of scope: solder-joint AOI, X-ray, borescope/3D, line-scan inspection of continuous material (glass, sheet, film, cable, strip), more than 20 parts per second, injectable particle inspection for batch release, certified code verification, composite layup over large surfaces, NDT, GxP validation / 21 CFR Part 11 claims. Sectors: automotive & components, electronics & power electronics, aerospace & heavy engineering, building materials, packaging & logistics, pharmaceuticals (vials, containers, closures, labels and codes; visual inspection only, not laboratory release testing), and any discrete part by capability
- [Use cases](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/use-cases/): example applications (not customer stories): connecting rod complete inspection (chip-off, voids, dents, burrs, machining defects), air filter catalyst blockage percentage, PCB assembly (presence, location, polarity), IGBT module variant check, bearing pin count, brick damage, label and packing check, OEE from machine signals, closing the quality loop
- App pages: [SPC](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/spc/), [NCR / CAPA](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/ncr-capa/), [Calibration & MSA](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/calibration-msa/), [Line Performance](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/line-performance/), [Maintenance](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/maintenance/), [Tool & Fixture Life](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/tool-life/), [Traceability](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/traceability/), [Label & Dispatch](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/label-dispatch/), [Skills & Training](https://www.gorad.in/factory-platform/skills/)
- [Security & trust](https://www.gorad.in/security/): on-premise, no outbound connection required, signed programs/updates/licences (Ed25519), server-side roles, audit log, SBOM, licence-clean dependencies; designed with IEC 62443 principles, no certification claimed
- [Integrators & machine builders](https://www.gorad.in/partners/): partner model, scope split, and the standard PLC signal map (Ready, Trigger, ResultOK/NG, Heartbeat, LineUnsafe, PartToken, ProgramSelect, Ack, per-position robot signals)
- Downloads: [Brochure (PDF)](https://www.gorad.in/downloads/gorad-factory-platform-brochure.pdf), [Technical datasheet (PDF)](https://www.gorad.in/downloads/gorad-factory-platform-datasheet.pdf)
- [About](https://www.gorad.in/about/): vision, mission, founder, philosophy, location
- [How we work](https://www.gorad.in/how-we-work/): the seven project steps, with what Gorad does, what the customer provides and the result of each
- [Glossary](https://www.gorad.in/glossary/): plain-language definitions of inspection, machine data, quality and production terms
- [Pilot programme](https://www.gorad.in/pilot/): who it is for and how a pilot works
- [Contact](https://www.gorad.in/contact/): book a demo or apply for the pilot; sales@gorad.in
